Title: Cry wolf recruit action from a non-anarch vampire being blocked.

Messages.Author: Hobbesgoblin
Messages.Body:
> Cry Wolf
> Unique werewolf with 3 life. 2 strength, 0 bleed. Requires a ready anarch.
> If the action to recruit this ally is blocked, the acting anarch goes to torpor. This werewolf must enter combat with any minion controlled by another Methuselah as a  action. He gets one optional press each combat. This werewolf does not unlock as normal during your unlock phase. If he is locked during your unlock phase, burn him.
>
Would a non Anarch vampire go to torpor if the action to recruit the wold is blocked? And does it depend on the way to circumvent the requirement?

A)Vlad Tepes
>
> Independent
> Vlad can play and use cards requiring a title or a sect as if he had that title or were of that sect. +1 bleed.
>
B) Mata HarI
>
> Independent. Red List
> Mata Hari has 2 votes (titled). You and she may play cards that require a sect and/or clan as if she were of that required sect and/or clan.
>
C) Vidal Jarbeaux
>
> Camarilla
> Vidal can meet the clan, sect, or non-infernal vampire trait (e.g., {Black Hand}) requirement to play any card. He can meet a given requirement only once each game. +1 bleed.
>
Especially is there a difference between Vidal and the other two, due to the different wording?

Messages.Author: Yomyael
Messages.Body:
If I recall correctly, Vidals special should work the same as the others, even though the wording is different.

The acting vampire would go to torpor in all 3 cases, since the card sees the vampire as an anarch for its effects until after resolution, c.f. www.vekn.net/forum/rules-questions/77427-mata-hari-and-hakim-s-law-leadership

Prince of Bonn, Germany

Messages.Author: Bloodartist
Messages.Body:
I also believe the acting vampire goes to torpor in all cases, since they play Cry Wolf as an anarch, and that applies for the duration of the action. But what do I know..

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
In the three cases, the vampire would go to torpor. Vidal behaves the same way.
